direction: Pokemon-style 2D/2.5D, NOT voxel. Descriptions from the pasted canon manifests.

entries.appendages: Massive, glowing electric talons. Tail feathers like three jagged lightning bolts.
entries.base: Massive, imposing avian frame with an incredibly wide wingspan.
entries.concept: Giant, majestic eagle that summons dark clouds and lightning when it flaps.
entries.material_color: Deep storm-cloud grey #4a5568 feathers transitioning to crackling electric yellow #ffee00 at the wingtips.
entries.name: Stormtalon
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Wrapped in a dynamic, dark cloud particle emitter. Random jagged lightning flashes silently within the cloud radius.

entries.appendages: Dorsal and pectoral fins are literal serrated kitchen knives.
entries.base: Flat, angular cylinder pinched at both ends to form a torpedo shape.
entries.concept: Small, aggressive fish with scales like razor blades.
entries.material_color: Highly polished, reflective steel #c0c0c0 with a glowing crimson #ff0033 underbelly.
entries.name: Finblade
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Cuts through the air, emitting a sharp metallic shing audio ping and leaving a faint slice-distortion behind it.

entries.appendages: Gaping maw filled with spinning, chainsaw-like fractal teeth. Massive, swept-back fighter-jet fins.
entries.base: Colossal, heavy capsule modified into a brutalist, submarine-like shark chassis.
entries.concept: Terrifying, chrome-plated shark that swims through the air as easily as water.
entries.material_color: Liquid mercury (high metallic, high roughness) reflecting the entire environment.
entries.name: Megalochrome
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Creates a localized anti-gravity water ripple around its body, warping visual space as it swims silently through the air.

entries.base: Squishy, perfectly round sphere with a tiny, flat tail.
entries.concept: Floating baby whale that makes cute, echoing sonar pings.
entries.material_color: Midnight blue #000033 on top, glowing starlight-white #f8f8ff belly.
entries.name: Floatcalf
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Every few seconds, emits a visible, expanding cyan sonar-ring (torus scaling up and fading out) with a cute echoing digital ping.

entries.appendages: Four massive, sweeping fins rowing through the air like oars on a cosmic galley.
entries.concept: Colossal, slow-moving whale with galaxies swirling inside its dark blue skin. Roster type is Aqua/Neon (file note: NEON, not COSMIC, fits the cyber universe).
entries.material_color: Pitch black #000000 skin filled with slowly rotating, parallax-mapped starfields, nebulas, and glowing purple #8a2be2 galaxies.
entries.name: Astroleviathan
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Smaller wild Mochiichao (and loose debris) gently orbit its gravitational pull if they get too close.

entries.appendages: Four tiny tentacles clutching the inside of the glass.
entries.base: Tiny, squishy dome hiding inside a transparent cylinder (the jar).
entries.concept: Squishy, shy octopus that hides in a floating digital jar.
entries.material_color: Octopus neon pink #ff00ff. Jar translucent glass with a glowing green neon cork.
entries.name: Inklet
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Jar bobs up and down. If the player gets too close, it squirts a cloud of digital black pixels obscuring the inside of the jar.

entries.appendages: Eight tentacles rigged with inverse kinematics, constantly writhing and slithering over each other like independent snakes.
entries.base: Medium-sized dome with eight flowing, segmented tentacles.
entries.concept: Brightly colored octopus with venomous, glowing rings.
entries.material_color: Toxic warning-yellow #ffff00 base, covered in pulsing, hypnotic neon-blue #0000ff rings.
entries.name: Toxitacle
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Drips heavy, glowing purple venom particles that sizzle and burn the floor.

entries.appendages: Tentacles so massive they clip into the ground; when it moves, they pull out, throwing up chunks of dirt, and anchor back down.
entries.base: Towering, jagged mantle shaped like an executioner's hood.
entries.concept: Massive, menacing kraken whose tentacles anchor deep into the ground.
entries.material_color: Deep, corrupted void-black #111111 with a single, massive, unblinking red #ff0000 mechanical eye in the center.
entries.name: Krakenox
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Emits a permanent, thick black fog around its base, obscuring its lower half completely.

entries.appendages: Oversized fists tightly wrapped in glowing white data-streams (boxing tape). Constantly hops foot to foot in an idle fighting stance.
entries.base: Small, blocky bipedal humanoid (classic RPG sprite).
entries.concept: Small, energetic bipedal fighter wrapping its hands in data-tape.
entries.material_color: Tan/beige chassis wearing a glowing red #cc0000 digital headband.
entries.name: Punchkid
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Emits tiny white impact sparks every time it punches the air during its idle animation.

entries.appendages: Arms are literal hydraulic pistons. Fists are massive, square anvils hissing with steam when compressed.
entries.base: Top-heavy, massive-shouldered humanoid built like a tank.
entries.concept: Heavy-hitting, armored boxer. Evolves from Punchkid if ATK > SPD (branching evolution).
entries.material_color: Deep crimson #990000 and brushed gold #ffd700 armor plating.
entries.name: Strikechamp
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: On attack, arm pistons fire backward, venting a massive cloud of white steam before snapping forward.

entries.appendages: Arms kept crossed or resting. Legs heavily elongated, ending in sharp, aerodynamic bladed feet.
entries.base: Tall, incredibly lean and aerodynamic humanoid silhouette.
entries.concept: Lean, lightning-fast martial artist. Evolves from Punchkid if SPD > ATK (branching evolution).
entries.material_color: Sleek midnight blue #000066 with neon cyan #00ffff racing stripes down its legs.
entries.name: Kickmaster
entries.status: SPEC — described in pasted manifest, not yet a sprite
entries.vfx: Moves so fast it leaves a transparent motion-blur ghost (after-image) lagging exactly one frame behind it.

note: Roster numbering. Branching evolution for Punchkid is a design rule from the paste, not yet in game code.
